sentences.text: For Respondent(s) : Mr. Prem Singh Panwar  HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE KULDEEP MATHUR Order 11/12/2024 Learned counsel for the petitioner does not press this bail application but seeks liberty that the petitioner may be permitted to surrender before the trial Court and file an application for bail.
Accordingly, the instant application for bail is dismissed as not pressed.
The petitioner is directed to surrender before the trial Court on or before 06.01.2025 and file an application for bail.
It is expected from the trial Court that the bail application will be decided as expeditiously as possible.

Till 06.01.2025, the petitioner shall not be arrested in connection with FIR No.97/2024, registered at Police Station Chaupasani Housing Board, District Jodhpur City West for the offences under Sections 376, 384, 354-D of IPC and Sections 66 & 67 of the IT Act.
